fieldNotes.operationalStatus: OPERATIONAL, but NOT a bottling plant. This blank-flag BlueTriton/Primo site is the company's WOODRIDGE READYREFRESH DELIVERY BRANCH at 10335 Argonne Woods Dr, Woodridge IL 60517 (Ice Mountain Direct / ReadyRefresh home-and-office water delivery). Confirmed active by 2025 BlueTriton job postings for this location: Route Delivery Drivers (CDL + non-CDL, commission), Heavy Equipment Mechanic, Order Manager, Back-of-House Shift Manager, and Branch Operations Manager, all geo-tagged Woodridge IL. Ice Mountain spring water is actually BOTTLED in Stanwood MI, not here; Woodridge is a regional distribution/route-delivery branch occupying a suite in a multi-tenant industrial park. The 'Bottling plant (PL)' type on the source list is a mislabel for this site. No closure/demolition found; satellite shows an active operation (box-truck/cube-van delivery fleet staged, trailers backed to docks, forklift activity in the court).
fieldNotes.siteResolution: Given coords were unknown. Geocoded 10335 Argonne Woods Dr -> 41.6988,-88.0086, inside the Internationale Centre business park. Satellite resolved two large aligned multi-tenant warehouse/flex buildings (west tan-roof, east dark-roof) sharing a central truck court. Address pages (BBB, ReadyRefresh, Bandana) place BlueTriton at 10335 Argonne Woods Dr Suite 200; the adjacent 10330 building (Street View 2018) is a separate tenant ('Mid...Office...Inter...' Suite 600), confirming the multi-tenant nature. Audited the operational complex (both buildings + shared court) since the exact suite footprint within the building cannot be isolated from overhead and the freight footprint is shared.
fieldNotes.truckGate: FALSE. No barrier arm, sliding/swing gate, or guard booth anywhere where the property meets Argonne Woods Dr. Open business-park driveways at the NW and SW; trucks enter the shared court directly off the public road. Low confidence only in that the relevant tenant could badge a man-door, but no vehicular gate exists on imagery.
fieldNotes.guardShack: FALSE. No booth-sized (1-3 vehicle footprint, multi-window) structure at any entrance. This is an open multi-tenant park.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: FALSE - no truck gate exists, so by rubric remoteGs is false.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: East (dark-roof) building: dock bank along the NORTH face (z20 north-docks tile shows ~4-6 cube vans/box trucks and 2-3 semi-trailers backed in) plus a dock line along the WEST face fronting the court. West (tan-roof) building: docks on its EAST face fronting the court. Honest total across the shared court ~16-20 -> banded 10-25. Multi-tenant so not all serve the BlueTriton branch.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Trailers and delivery box trucks parked in the shared court without tractors (~10-15 across the north court and west-building east apron). Banded 10-25. Mix of OTR trailers and ReadyRefresh delivery fleet.
fieldNotes.dropYard: TRUE - the central paved court between the two buildings functions as a trailer/fleet drop and staging lot distinct from the active dock faces.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: FALSE/uncertain - docks are distributed across multiple faces of both buildings but this is a function of multi-tenancy, not a deliberate split ship/receive layout for one operator; cannot confirm function from imagery.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: TRUE - the large open paved court inside the complex (no gate, but a clear internal holding/queue apron) lets trucks stage before backing to docks.
fieldNotes.preGateStaging: FALSE - no gate, and no dedicated wait apron between the public road and the complex.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: TRUE - the entry off Argonne Woods Dr plus the deep internal court easily holds a 3+ truck queue before docks.
fieldNotes.backupSensitive: FALSE - ample paved court and parking to absorb a queue; no spillover risk onto the public road.
fieldNotes.entryExitTogether: TRUE - trucks use the same NW driveway group to enter and leave the shared court; no separate dedicated out-gate.
fieldNotes.entryLanes: Single shared driveway lane in / out -> entryLanes 1, exitLanes 1 (estimate; uncontrolled open drive).
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: FALSE - no gate to bypass; open access already.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: TRUE - the property is a two-building multi-tenant complex (campus); BlueTriton is one tenant of several.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: 2 primary large buildings (west tan-roof, east dark-roof) plus a small fenced equipment/utility area at the NW court; counted as 2.
fieldNotes.trailersVisible: ~4-6 box trucks/cube vans + ~2-3 OTR semis at the north court + scattered trailers along the west-building east apron = ~12 honest estimate; mixed-vintage imagery, approximate.
fieldNotes.trailerParkingCapacity: Shared court + west apron could hold ~25 trailers/box trucks across tenants.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: ~8.5 acres for the enclosed operational core (two buildings + central court + immediate parking, inside the treeline buffer). The wider park is larger but the rest is other parcels/landscaping.
fieldNotes.railServed: FALSE - no rail spur enters the property; the BNSF/Metra line is well to the north, not connected.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Urban - dense suburban DuPage County (Woodridge / Downers Grove, Chicago metro), surrounded by business parks, apartments, and residential subdivisions.
fieldNotes.connectivityIssue: FALSE - dense Chicago-metro suburb, strong cellular coverage.
